MJF — heel ace and former AEW World Champion.

How Maxwell Jacob Friedman connects

  • Item: AEW World Championship — MJF's world-title reign was a long heel-ace chapter.
  • Character: Cody Rhodes — MJF's early peak was the long feud with Cody Rhodes.
  • Faction: Undisputed Kingdom — Undisputed Kingdom's AEW chapter crossed MJF and Adam Cole.

What is Maxwell Jacob Friedman?

Maxwell Jacob Friedman is AEW's long-running heel star: Dynamite Diamond Ring, Salt of the Earth, a world-title reign, and feuds with Cody Rhodes, CM Punk, and Adam Cole.

Key threads lead to AEW World Championship, Cody Rhodes and Undisputed Kingdom.
